sheet-81.description: Sheet 81 of the New Jersey Coast volume 1 shows the centre of East Oceanic, today part of the Borough of Rumson, at 60 feet to an inch, with north toward the upper right. The sheet covers the blocks between Black Point Road along the top and Ridge Road, which crosses the lower part of the sheet diagonally, and between the block west of Main Road and the land east of the Avenue of Two Rivers. Centre runs north and south through the middle. The area is thinly built: mostly two-storey frame dwellings on large lots, many lots still empty. West of Main Road the long glass roofs of the F. McMahon greenhouses fill most of a block, with heaters, a 30 ft chimney, an office, an ice house and a dwelling; a blacksmith shop and a small hotel with a saloon stand near Black Point Road. A public school stands on Black Point Road between Main Road and Centre. East of Centre the large lot of The Armide Rest holds a big frame house with a windmill and tank, and the Ellen Cottage is drawn at an angle near the Avenue of Two Rivers. A fire department hose wagon house stands on Centre near Ridge Road. The Hotel Monmouth occupies the corner east of the Avenue of Two Rivers at Ridge Road, and a dwelling being built stands further east. An 18 inch water pipe is drawn in Main Road, Ridge Road and the Avenue of Two Rivers, with hydrants at three corners. A note gives the population as 350, prevailing winds west, water facilities as in the Long Branch report, no steam or hand engine, 1200 ft of hose and one independent hose wagon. The blank margins belong to sheets 82 and 83.
notes: Main Road is today East River Road; Centre is Center Street (Rumson).
The unnamed 50 ft street west of Main Road between the hotel block and the greenhouse block is today Carton Street.
Ridge Road continues south-east past the Avenue of Two Rivers toward sheet 82.
Population note: 350; water facilities see Long Branch report; no steam or hand engine; 1200 ft 2 1/2 in hose; 1 independent hose wagon.

Printed sheet 81 of N.J. Coast vol. 1, East Oceanic (Rumson). Scale 60 ft to an inch, north toward upper right (fitted rotation about 31 deg; the arrow is about 20 deg, likely magnetic). One part. Streets: Black Point R'd, Main R'd (East River Road), Centre (Center Street), Avenue of Two Rivers, Ridge R'd, unnamed street = Carton Street. Surveyed 8-6-07.
